== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-4lomsconcussionrifle-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[4-LOM's Concussion Rifle]]: The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “a character or creature” is added after “. May target”; “during a battle” is removed; “Character hit if” becomes “If”; “-X &gt; ability, where X =” becomes “-”; “&gt; defense value, target hit” is added after “distance to target”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•4-LOM’s Concussion Rifle” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
